title: Sandboxes can outlast a day
summary:
Longer-lived sandboxes, better Discord follow-ups, and reasoning replay landed alongside app-catalog and cache fixes.

Sandbox timeouts can now extend beyond E2B’s 24-hour run limit through the existing API calls, with `polli sandbox create --timeout` and `polli sandbox pause` added to the CLI. Daily restarts preserve files, memory, and processes, but drop open connections. Opt-in support for a 4 vCPU, 8 GB `pollinations-large` template was also added alongside the unchanged default; the PR did not create the E2B template.

Polli’s Discord conversations now queue messages that arrive while it is working, rather than rejecting them. It can respond to follow-ups with text, reactions, or both, and its support guidance now points it toward current model catalogs.

The stateless `/v1/responses` endpoint now accepts replayed encrypted reasoning items used by Codex-style clients, while Azure Responses calls can return JSON without waiting for a long upstream call before receiving headers. Updated docs explain how to pass reasoning between turns and which stored-response features remain unsupported.

daily.title: Sandboxes beyond 24 hours
daily.text: Set sandbox timeouts beyond a day through the existing API calls or `polli sandbox create --timeout`. Daily restarts preserve files, memory, and processes, but drop open connections. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: A larger sandbox option
daily.text: Sandbox creation now supports opting into `pollinations-large`, a 4 vCPU, 8 GB template, alongside the unchanged 2 vCPU, 2 GB default. The E2B template itself was not created by this change. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Polli takes follow-ups
daily.text: Send a follow-up while Polli is working in Discord: it can queue the message for its next model call instead of rejecting it. Replies can include text, reactions, or both. [Visit the community chat](https://chat.pollinations.ai).
